title: Redmond Farm Guide
subtitle: A short guide to how Redmond Farms teams move nourishing food from farm to market.

pages.title: Heritage Farm
pages.description: Redmond's Heritage Farm team includes the farmers and the dairy cows, pigs, and chickens they care for.
body: Our caretakers incorporate intentional, regenerative farming methods to ensure happy and healthy animals.
They also develop and produce our signature farm products.
pages.imageAlt: Dairy cow at Redmond Heritage Farm
pages.caption: Farm-raised staples begin with caretakers, animals, and intentional methods.

pages.title: Heritage Farm Products
pages.description: Raw dairy, eggs, and meat raised with care and shaped by regenerative methods that keep nutrient density at the center.
pages.caption: Raw dairy, eggs, and meat stay at the center of the farm's staple products.

pages.title: Redmond Farm Market
pages.description: Redmond Farm Markets exist to provide our communities with nourishing products from our farm, production kitchen, and like-minded suppliers.
body: Market teams connect people with farm-raised products, House Made creations, and products from thoughtful suppliers.

pages.title: Farm Kitchen
pages.description: Redmond Farm Kitchen brings nutrient density, convenience, and flavor together into a casual dining experience.
body: Kitchen associates prepare, cook, and serve nutrient-dense foods and drinks while keeping the restaurant running smoothly.
Meals are sourced primarily from the Heritage Farm, Production Kitchen, and other local partners.
pages.imageAlt: Prepared Redmond food and dairy products

pages.title: Farm Market Truck
pages.description: A mini Redmond Market on wheels.
body: Servicing about five stops each week, the truck brings farm staples and House Made products to customers who do not live near a store location.
The team builds relationships with regular customers and keeps communication updated when the truck has downtime.

pages.title: Production Kitchen
pages.description: The Redmond Production Kitchen generates the House Made product line and supports the Farm Kitchens.
body: Production Kitchen associates create new products, prepare food, and make recipes in large batches.
Providing products that we fully trust allows our customers to fully trust us.

pages.title: Freight Trucks
pages.description: Two refrigerated box delivery trucks deliver farm products and distribute goods between stores.
body: The team moves farm products, House Made items, and other ingredients between the Heritage Farm, Production Kitchen, and Market/Kitchen locations.
The truck also completes additional transfers and takes milk to the state-certified lab for testing.

pages.title: A Connected System
pages.description: Each part of Redmond Farms supports the next, creating a practical system for nourishing food and community access.
body: The Heritage Farm raises staple products, the Production Kitchen creates House Made items, the Markets and Kitchens serve customers directly, and the truck teams keep products moving.
Together, the system keeps intentionally sourced food close to the people it serves.
